ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 7-G in an area bound by:

Starting at the alley next north of and parallel to West Oakdale Avenue; a line 291.00 feet west of and
parallel to North Sheffield Avenue; West Oakdale Avenue; and a line 316.00 feet west of and parallel to

North Sheffield Avenue.

To those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1030 W Oakdale Ave, Chicago, IL 60657
